definitions.explanation: An electronic device for performing mathematical calculations.

examples.japanese: {電卓|でんたく}で{計算|けいさん}する。
{試験|しけん}には{電卓|でんたく}を{持|も}ち{込|こ}めない。
examples.english: You can't bring a calculator to the exam.

examples.japanese: スマホの{電卓|でんたく}アプリを{使|つか}う。
examples.english: To use the calculator app on my smartphone.

notes:
{電卓|でんたく} is short for {電子卓上計算機|でんしたくじょうけいさんき}.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {電|でん}: electronic
- {卓|たく}: table/desktop

NOTE:
Although phone calculator apps are common, physical calculators are still used in business and accounting.
